_about: Scores in this run that a re-judge with the current verifier may change. Each was judged with a rubric line or check evidence that the paper-only audit (tests/test_hard_tasks.py) later ruled out, or with fewer than three judge votes. The stored grades are kept as graded; scripts/regrade_jobs.py --judge --all refreshes them.
claude-sonnet-5.5/opentrons-rna-extracti: Marked down for recovering the whole 100 uL eluate; the paper says only 'collect the supernatant', the 80 uL is in the authors' code. Rubric fixed since.
gpt-6.1-sol/opentrons-rna-extraction-har: Marked down for recovering the whole 100 uL eluate; the paper says only 'collect the supernatant', the 80 uL is in the authors' code. Rubric fixed since.
